additional_info.subject: ID0446273-DC/Si-D/QA-[MP / N5 160345957]Charging issue CRM:02698000466
additional_info.body:
Hello Joseph,
I believe I've found the error:
The voltage is not building properly on the Voltage Transducer - this means that even though the converters are reaching the CableCheck voltage, the Voltage transducer is not recognizing it fully.
This can mean only 1 of 3 things:
Contactor is not closing properly
TF2 is not good
XD10.3
This is what might be seen and we don't want to:
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Do you have any spare parts with you that we can use? The only 2 things we might need is QA13-14 and TF2. If you don't have these components, then we can test swapping TF1 and TF2:
If problem is fixed, that means some wiring was loose
If problem is not fixed, then:
We need power down the charger and check this XD10.3, open the converter plate from the front and push the connectors from inside-outside to make sure they are properly attached.
If the problem is still not fixed, then that means we need to replace the contactors.
I will schedule a call with you for tomorrow, feel free to change the time to fit your schedule.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0446273-DC/Si-D/QA-[MP / N5 160345957]Charging issue CRM:02698000466
additional_info.body:
Hello Joseph, good morning.
After today's site visit, we were able to find the root cause.
Since we didn't have any spare parts to work with, we managed by swapping TF1 and TF2 and also checking XD10.3 but nothing changed. We were able to reach Pre Charge but the required voltage is never reached.
For CableCheck we must reach 200V and PreCharge 150V but we never go past 130 V.
From my side, you can order new QA13-14 with the following MLFB:
8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
Please order 2x of these.
Since we provided a solution, can I close the ticket? Since this charger is out of warranty, I cannot support any further without a purchase order that you can align with Thangal.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
